subject: Recap: econ stakeholder map + pilot pricing for Acme Health

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Recap: econ stakeholder map + pilot pricing for Acme Health

Thanks again for taking time today, Sarah — good conversation and helpful context. Quick recap and asks so we have alignment before we put together the formal pilot quote.

Summary of what we covered:
- Pilot scope: conversational triage + summarization for patient intake (approx. 3–6 prompt types).
- Expected steady-state utilization: ~20M–50M tokens/month during evaluation window (you mentioned seasonality could push to the high end).
- Technical success criteria: 90th pctile latency <500ms for 2k token context, fidelity on safety checks.

Open items / asks from Acme (please confirm):
1) Who is the economic buyer / budget owner for this pilot (name + title)?
2) Who needs to approve finance terms (PO vs. contract sign, net terms)?
3) Target unit price per 1M tokens that would make this path viable for you (even a range is fine).
4) Any procurement constraints (preferred payment method, SOC2 evidence, contract start timeline)?

Next steps from Redwood:
- I’ll share a preliminary pricing matrix and a short mutual action plan for signature. (attached)
- Rafael will draft a couple of sample unit-price bands so you can see tradeoffs on latency vs. cost.
- Proposed next call: 30 minutes with Tom (budget owner) + Maya (finance) to align approvals. Please advise availability.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx (draft), mutual_action_plan_acme.pdf (MVP).

Thanks — Neha

Thanks Neha — added a few notes inline.

Neha wrote: "Open items / asks from Acme (please confirm): 1) Who is the economic buyer... 3) Target unit price per 1M tokens..."

Quick internal perspective for Sarah:
- Pricing bands we typically propose for pilots like this (examples):
  * Band A (latency-focused): $450 / 1M tokens — smaller batch sizes, higher throughput SLA.
  * Band B (balanced): $300 / 1M tokens — standard batching, recommended for evaluation.
  * Band C (cost-first): $200 / 1M tokens — aggressive quantization/throughput tradeoffs, slightly higher failure/fallback rate.

- If your target is around $250–300 / 1M tokens we can likely hit a Band B offer and include a 30–60 day evaluation credit to accelerate sign-off.
- Procurement note: Acme’s request for PO/net-30 is common; we can accept PO but prefer a short SOW for pilot scope clarity.

Sarah — if you can confirm who signs budget and who handles the PO, I’ll prepare the Band B quote and a short addendum outlining any perf tradeoffs.

Rafael Mendes | Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

Appreciate the clear recap, Neha. Confirming details from our side:

- Economic buyer / budget owner: Tom Rivera, VP of Product (tom.rivera@acmehealth.com). He owns the pilot budget and will be the final sign-off.
- Finance approver: Maya Singh (maya.singh@acmehealth.com) — handles PO terms and vendor onboarding.
- Target economics: we’re looking at a pilot spend in the $150k–$300k range overall. For unit economics, our internal target to consider full rollout is ~ $275 / 1M tokens (we realize this depends on latency/quality tradeoffs).
- Expected token profile: start at ~20M/month, with a potential ramp to 45–50M/month if initial results are positive.
- Procurement: Acme prefers PO + net 30. We can do a short SOW for the pilot; legal will want terms redlined.

If you can share the Band B sample pricing Rafael mentioned and a short call invite for Tom + Maya + our legal lead, we’ll confirm availability. Thanks — Sarah
